The '''Bala D'ur Slaver Camps''' was the hideout of [[Bala D'ur]] pirates on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It doubled as a slaver camp, in which they kept their [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] prisoners, working them to death.<ref name="Humanitarian Aid" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bala D'ur Slaver Camps appear as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Humanitarian Aid" />
